declared_command: cargo test -p hypermid-memory --manifest-path crates/hypermid-memory/Cargo.toml && PYTHONPATH=runtime python -m pytest -q checks/hypermid/test_memory_oss_integration.py checks/hypermid/test_memory_release_diagnostics.py
scope: The real Python-to-Rust daemon journey passed on a clean source profile and a separate clean restored profile. It covers authenticated record creation and retrieval, maintenance fencing, canonical export/import, equivalent restored retrieval, scoped diagnostics for indexes, vectors, queue, leases, budgets and recovery, and diagnostic redaction. Rust crate-wide evidence and focused post-gate delta evidence are preserved separately.
source_adjustments: The release check resolves its default daemon binary from the repository target directory while preserving the HYPERMID_DAEMON_BINARY override.
MemoryDiagnostics accepts the additive index, budget and recovery fields and treats their absence conservatively for older daemons.
The declared OSS integration and release diagnostics tests now execute complete production daemon journeys.
